title: Skeletal Muscle Extraction from AllProtect Tissue Reagent
author: Elisabeth Heuston

steps.title: Prepare Tissue and Remove Storage Reagent
steps.instruction: Thaw tissue stored in AllProtect® Tissue Reagent on ice and remove the reagent through serial dilution.

substeps.instruction: Thaw tissue stored in AllProtect® Tissue Reagent on ice
Serially dilute and exchange AllProtect® Tissue Reagent with PBS until all storage reagent has been removed

steps.title: Create Single Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Pulverize the tissue and perform initial filtration to obtain a cell suspension.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend tissue in 0.5 mL pBSA
Pulverize tissue to single cell suspension using a single-use microtube homogenizer
Filter through a 70 µm strainer into a fresh 1.5 mL tube
Rinse the strainer with 0.5 mL pBSA

steps.title: Wash and Refine Cell Suspension
steps.instruction: Centrifuge and perform a second filtration to obtain filtered cells.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 5 min at 300xg, 4°C
Remove supernatant and resuspend in 0.5 mL pBSA
Filter through a 40 µm strainer into a fresh 1.5 mL tube
Rinse the strainer with 0.5 mL pBSA

steps.title: Prepare First Cell Aliquot for Capture
steps.instruction: Isolate and resuspend a specific cell count for Chromium Single Cell 5’ Library & Gel Bead Kit v2 sample capture.

substeps.instruction: Remove ~60,000 cells to a fresh 1.5 mL tube
Centrifuge for 5 min at 300 xg, 4°C
Resuspend 60,000 cells in 30 µL pBSA

steps.title: Extract Nuclei from Second Cell Aliquot
steps.instruction: Isolate cells and process them into nuclei for Chromium Single Cell 5’ Library & Gel Bead Kit v2 sample capture.

substeps.instruction: Remove 250,000 cells to a fresh 1.5 mL tube
Centrifuge for 5 min at 300 xg, 4°C
Resuspend in 100 µL Nuclei Extraction Buffer
Incubate on ice for 5 min
Centrifuge for 5 min at 300 xg, 4°C
Resuspend in 30 µL Nuclei Buffer

steps.title: Stain and Sort Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare unstained controls and stain cells for FACS sorting.

substeps.instruction: Remove 50,000 cells as an unstained cell control (bring minimum volume to 100 µL)
Stain 500,000 cells with a final concentration of 25 µg/mL NPC-AF594
Incubate on ice for 30 min
Centrifuge for 5 min at 300xg, 4°C
Resuspend in 300 µL pBSA
Sort NPC-AF594+ cells on a Becton Dickinson FACS Aria Fusion using a 70 µm nozzle into a collection tube on ice

steps.title: Prepare Sorted Cell Aliquot for Capture
steps.instruction: Isolate and resuspend sorted cells for Chromium Single Cell 5’ Library & Gel Bead Kit v2 sample capture.

substeps.instruction: Remove ~100,000 sorted cells to a fresh 1.5 mL tube
Centrifuge for 5 min at 300 xg, 4°C
Resuspend 60,000 cells in 30 µL pBSA

steps.title: Extract Nuclei from Sorted Cells
steps.instruction: Isolate sorted cells and process them into nuclei for Chromium Single Cell 5’ Library & Gel Bead Kit v2 sample capture.

substeps.instruction: Remove 250,000 sorted cells to a fresh 1.5 mL tube
Centrifuge for 5 min at 300 xg, 4°C
Resuspend in 100 µL Nuclei Extraction Buffer
Incubate on ice for 5 min
Centrifuge for 5 min at 300 xg, 4°C
Resuspend in 30 µL Nuclei Buffer

steps.title: Prepare Sorted Cells/Nuclei for Imaging
steps.instruction: Stain sorted cells or nuclei and prepare them for confocal microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Start with up to 50,000 sorted cells (sorted cell capture preparation) or 50,000 sorted nuclei (sorted nuclei capture preparation) in 100 µL pBSA
Stain with a final concentration of 100 µg/mL NPC-AF594 + 50 µg/mL DAPI
Incubate on ice for 20 min
Centrifuge for 5 min at 300 xg, 4°C
Resuspend in 300 µL pBSA
Transfer suspension to a 35 mm 1.5 coverslip dish
Image on an LSM 880 Airyscan Confocal microscope (Zeiss) with a 63x/1.4 oil objective using Zen_2.3 software (Zeiss)
